mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over past 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 310.0, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 310.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% and housing starts exceed 1450 thousand units, it signals an overheating labor and housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 and HOUST > 1450, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (CPIAUCSL > 310.0 and GDP growth > 2% over the last quarter), a decline in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 310.0, GDPC1 growth > 2%, and UNRATE declined over past 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the past 3 months signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST increased over past 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 3.7% and employment growth (PAYEMS) falls below 0.5% annually, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE > 3.7 and PAYEMS growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an immediate tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased over past month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
